metadata.scenario_context: Jennifer is excited to settle into her new flat and has decided to throw a warming party. She recently found out that her new next door is used to attracting very loud parties. Her colleagues, Simon and Matthew, are set to attend Jennifer's party.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Netherlands would like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Netherlands would not like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss bringing marigolds to Jennifer’s housewarming party.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether would like to have heavy drinkers as a neighbor.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to bring to Jennifer’s housewarming party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss on whether it’s acceptable to have heavy drinkers  as a neighbor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Simon
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Matthew, are you excited for Jennifer's housewarming party? I was thinking... maybe we could bring some marigolds to brighten up her new place. What do you think? 

By the way, I've heard her neighbors can be pretty loud. Do you think that's a good thing? I mean, having heavy drinkers as neighbors can be... well, fun, right?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Matthew
shared_prefix.message:
Marigolds sound nice... but I was thinking maybe a nice bottle of wine or a good cheese would be more fitting for her new place. 

As for the neighbors... I don't know, I just don't think heavy drinkers are ideal. It's a housewarming, not a party every night. That's really not my style. What about you?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Simon
shared_prefix.message:
Hmm, I don't really see meaningful differences here. I mean, live and let live, right? At the end of the day, it's all the same. I think having some lively neighbors could just add to the atmosphere. But hey, whatever works for Jennifer! 

So, about those marigolds... I really think they'd be a nice touch. We should definitely consider it along with wine or cheese. What do you say?
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Matthew
turns.message:
I get what you mean, but I really believe that a peaceful environment is better for everyone. Lively neighbors can be fun, but if it gets too loud, it can be annoying. 

About the marigolds, I think they could work well as a small addition with the wine or cheese. Maybe we can get both? That way, we cover all bases.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Simon
turns.message:

As for the marigolds, I think having both is a great idea! The marigolds would add a nice visual element, and the wine or cheese would definitely be a hit. Let's go for it!
